create_transformer_encoder_layer: create a TransformerSentenceEncoderLayer with custom embedding dim and attention heads for BERT style models
build_self_attention: build a MultiheadAttention module with quantization noise support for the transformer encoder layer
build_fc1: build the first feed-forward linear layer with optional quantization noise for the encoder
build_fc2: build the second feed-forward linear layer with optional quantization noise for the encoder
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the transformer encoder layer with attention and padding masks
